text.p: 360 Communications Co said Tuesday it plans to recognize charges for unexpected events in the fourth quarter of 1996 that will cut earnings by $0.06 to $0.08 a share

360, which provides wireless communications services, cited an earnings shortfall from unconsolidated subsidiaries, a one-time federal income tax adjustment, and higher-than-projected fraud losses in late December.
"When the fraud losses became apparent in mid-January, 360 took immediate corrective action in all affected markets, including those acquired in late 1996," the company said in a statement.
360 said it expects to report fourth quarter and year-end 1996 results on February 14.
Chicago-based 360 Communications provides wireless voice and data services in more than 100 markets in 16 states. The company also offers residential long distance and paging services.
